notes: Brick masks store 10 rows × 40 bits; exterior side walls are bit 0 and bit 39. Each bit covers 6 × 18 pixels. Moving objects occupy 2 half-columns and 2 half-rows (12 × 18 pixels).
Coordinates are relative to the left side wall at VRAM CC02. Interior starts at halfX=1.
Goal plate is below the desired egg position: the plate starts where the successful egg ends, usually halfY=20 along the bottom. Render it as a floor marker, not a full blocking tile.
The tileGrid is a convenient 19 × 10 interior transcription. ? means a brick occupies only one of the two 6-pixel halves, so use exact brickMasks when present.
Objects are big-endian VRAM addresses: white egg, goal plate, zero-terminated rocks, zero-terminated ghosts, zero-terminated frogs, zero-terminated mushrooms. Remaining bytes may carry flags.
